action.action_summary: Re-ran E12's exact pattern-detection method over the full current Experience Layer; excluded every group already known via E12/E23/E33+S-series/S1/S4/S13; applied S13's GPU-root-cause filter to any remaining structurally-new group; classified the remainder as CANDIDATE_ONLY only if both structurally new and causally independent, with real evidence_refs only.

result.note: Every qualifying group was already known or shared the existing GPU root cause -- correctly reported NO_NEW_IMPROVEMENT_SIGNAL rather than re-proposing S13s rejected signal or fabricating a new one.

cause.root_cause_summary: S12/S13s own real Experience captures joined already-excluded grouping keys rather than forming any new one, so re-running the same detection method over a slightly larger Experience Layer correctly finds nothing new this time -- the absence of a new signal is itself the honest, expected result of a real dataset that has not yet produced a genuinely different real cause.

lesson: Re-exploring for new signals after a rejection means running the same honest method again over the grown dataset and checking the GPU-root-cause filter against every remaining candidate, not silently re-trying the same rejected grouping key hoping a different independence verdict emerges -- and reporting NO_NEW_IMPROVEMENT_SIGNAL is the correct outcome when that is genuinely what the current real data supports.
